install.notes: The upstream task pack is an external Isaac Lab 3.0.0 extension: the sim path needs Isaac Sim 6.0.0 or 6.0.1 on Ubuntu 22.04+ with a recent NVIDIA driver (docs/01_install_isaaclab_release-3.0.0-beta2.md:9-12), Isaac Lab v3.0.0-beta2.patch1, torch and the installed rpl-centrifuge package. The gate and the fake backend need none of these; no simulator or hardware run was performed.
